bannerTooltip: The Provost is speaking the sentence that names you, one clause a round. Survive until she reaches its last word. Until then, lethal damage leaves you at 1 health.
traitorLine: {traitor_short} has one palm on the sphere and the other hand drawn back toward the lectern. It lands when the sentence does.
openingLog: The wards break from inside. The Keepers do not wait for you to turn around.

openingStrike.log: Their first spell takes you between the shoulders.

volleys.name: The Corrected Text
volleys.log: {caster}: The Corrected Text. {target} takes {damage}, and its next action is struck from the minutes.

volleys.name: The First Argument
volleys.log: {caster}: The First Argument. Storm breaks over {count} of them for {damage} each.

volleys.name: Terms
volleys.log: {caster}: Terms. Named for two turns, {damage} if they move: {targets}.

volleys.name: Last Orders
volleys.log: {caster}: Last Orders. A fallen Keeper rises where it fell, on your side.

volleys.name: Write That Down
volleys.log: {caster}: Write That Down. A turret off the apparatus lands beside you.

volleys.name: What they sat this morning
volleys.log: The class, from the tiers: {count} bolts of {damage}.

spendClassLog: From the east doors the Keepers read one spell together, at the tiers. The class goes down behind the benches. Not fallen. Spent.
spendArchmageLog: From the east doors the Keepers read one spell together, at the dais. {archmage} goes down on one knee. Not fallen. Spent.
floorLog: More of them come through the doors.
climaxDrawLog: 'Step forward and be written.' The half-written line draws you off the floor and onto your mark.
climaxSpellLog: {traitor_short}'s hand comes up, and the spell leaves it.
freezeLog: {count} of them still stand, every one stopped mid-step.
freezeLogOne: One of them still stands, stopped mid-step.
freezeLogNone: Not one of them is left standing.
walkHint: You can move. Nothing else can. Walk out through the east doors.
walkBlocked: They stand between you and the doors, and they will not move. Get as near the doors as you can.
hoverDoors: The east doors, and the way out.
hoverGround: The {element} here stopped where it was.
